test_title: PYST 51: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate one-word substitution of the given group of words.

A pretence of having a virtuous character, moral or religious beliefs or principles, etc., that one does not really possess.
solution: The correct answer is Option 4. i.e. **Hypocrisy.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Hypocrisy: **The practice of claiming to have moral standards or beliefs to which one's behaviour does not conform; insincerity. (पाखंड; नैतिक मानकों या मान्यताओं का दावा करने की प्रथा जिसके अनुरूप किसी का अपना व्यवहार नहीं होता है) • **Example: **He preached honesty but often lied, showing his hypocrisy. • Hypocrisy accurately interprets the given group of words. Therefore, the correct answer is Hypocrisy. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Shrewdness:** Having or showing sharp powers of judgment; astute. (तीक्ष्ण बुद्धि; निर्णय की तीक्ष्ण शक्तियाँ होना या प्रदर्शित करना) • **Naivety:** Lack of experience, wisdom, or judgment; innocence. (अनुभव, बुद्धि, या निर्णय की कमी; सरलता) • **Gullibility: **Easily deceived or tricked; overly trusting. (भोलाभालापन; आसानी से धोखा खा जाना) 39:Ta4e, The correct answer is 'Option 1' i.e. **'made a pig’s ear.'**
